designReviewFindings.finding: Tool registration alone restored arbitrary fields and embedded credentials to scripts/services.
designReviewFindings.resolution: Explicit host adapters/fields and private recipient planning before original payload release.

designReviewFindings.finding: The ordinary workspace guard permits authorized UNC/mapped drives and can fall back lexically on some realpath failures.
designReviewFindings.resolution: Separate local-medium proof before target filesystem probes; reject unknown medium and unresolved I/O.

designReviewFindings.finding: Drive broker killed an already-exited PID through delayed tree enumeration.
designReviewFindings.resolution: Fixed no-child script now terminates only a live owned ChildProcess handle; exit retires without kill. Independent subreview confirmed.

designReviewFindings.finding: Drive broker cleanup/stream errors could escape event handlers.
designReviewFindings.resolution: Catch cleanup failures and fail closed on stdout/stderr errors; late retired child events cannot affect the new owner. Independent subreview confirmed.

designReviewFindings.finding: Leaf mtime/size/inode recipient identity rejects legitimate atomic replacement and batch operations.
designReviewFindings.resolution: Bind canonical recipient/topology rather than unrelated content edits; preserve normal local operations.

designReviewFindings.finding: Bare native names can collide with exact host MCP route names.
designReviewFindings.resolution: Bind actual host route/recipient kind during planning and actual dispatch, including proxy targets.

designReviewFindings.finding: Normalization/proxy cloning can lose private WeakMap bindings after arguments already contain originals.
designReviewFindings.resolution: Transfer or rebuild host binding explicitly; do not interpret a copied restored tree as a new no-reference call.

designReviewFindings.finding: Permission updatedInput may introduce new secrets or change destination even when the old input had no references.
designReviewFindings.resolution: Reprotect and replan every host permission edit before dispatch.

designReviewFindings.finding: Existing todo items:[string] form must continue to work with references.
designReviewFindings.resolution: Normalize and authorize legitimate text fields without losing the binding.

designReviewFindings.finding: Session state tools need a final synchronous check after asynchronous authorization returns.
designReviewFindings.resolution: Assert in the synchronous actual state-commit section, not only inside the prior async helper.

designReviewFindings.finding: Authorization failure at atomic rename left a plaintext owned temporary file.
designReviewFindings.resolution: Clean only the owned temporary before preserving the original refusal; never run the in-place fallback on privacy errors. Independent real-FileTextIo reproduction and frozen 22-unit run passed after repair.

designReviewFindings.finding: Canonical local junction roots were rejected by lexical-only I/O recipient matching and could be swallowed into empty search results.
designReviewFindings.resolution: Match verified canonical paths while retaining original link-topology checks; propagate privacy errors instead of treating them as empty directories. Real junction private-query search passes.

designReviewFindings.finding: Case-only move revocation could block restorative rollback and then discard checkpoints.
designReviewFindings.resolution: Allow narrowly owned local rollback despite policy/cancellation changes; retain partial status, intermediate location and checkpoints if rollback fails. Windows real successful-rollback branch passed; failed-rollback branch reviewed but not fault-injected.

designReviewFindings.finding: The eight-job DriveType broker capacity conflicted with concurrent call planning and many configured workspace roots.
designReviewFindings.resolution: Host preparation/root mapping and probe admission are bounded to four concurrent tasks; queued requests retain cancellation and total five-second deadline. Nine-call/nine-workspace read case and queued-cancel test pass.

designReviewFindings.finding: Repeated checks made a synthetic 100-small-file search much slower when its query contained a private reference.
designReviewFindings.resolution: Deduplicate path/drive/component inspection only within one I/O check segment, stop after a current permission root matches, then use a new segment for fresh actual and original-recipient checks; synchronous policy/reference assertions remain. No cross-I/O authority cache. Investigation below records the remaining cost.

designReviewFindings.finding: Private wide-write/outside-workspace guard still probed unrelated UNC roots only for diagnostic logging.
designReviewFindings.resolution: Private branch returns after actual local-medium and hard-floor checks without unrelated root probing; ordinary no-reference/off behavior remains. Regression observes zero UNC realpath calls and exact local credential writes.

limitations: This is a host restoration/disclosure contract, not OS isolation. Same-account filesystem races, scripts independently reading files and indirect file-then-execute workflows remain existing boundaries.

Only explicit local file/text/current-session adapters are authorized for original values; ordinary no-reference/off calls preserve the existing path. UNC/mapped/unknown drives and unadapted scripts/HTTP/MCP original inputs refuse.
No extra ordinary permission dialog/password/installation was added; private-reference file operations still pay destination and policy verification costs.
Actual media/HTTP/web-search/bot/export/MCP recipient adapters remain later M2/M4 batches; strict CLI/independent namespace and ASR remain paused.

Atomic owned-temp cleanup is best effort on OS/medium failures; failed move restoration preserves an explicit partial/intermediate/checkpoint receipt. Failed-rollback branch reviewed but not fault-injected; Windows successful rollback is tested.
No live-provider/live-matrix, real external platform, complete product E2E, new package, DPAPI storage migration or release acceptance is claimed.
